unit.can_do_en: return something and explain what is wrong.

brief.situation_en: Maria calls customer service. Juho answers.

lines.speaker: Juho
lines.gloss_en: Customer service, Juho speaking. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text_puhe: Moi! Mun uus pesukone ei käynnisty.
lines.text_kirja: Hei! Minun uusi pesukoneeni ei käynnisty.
lines.gloss_en: Hi! My new washing machine won't start.

lines.speaker: Juho
lines.gloss_en: Sorry to hear that. When did you buy it?

lines.speaker: Juho
lines.text_puhe: Sit siin on takuu. Me lähetetään huoltomies.
lines.text_kirja: Sitten siinä on takuu. Me lähetämme huoltomiehen.
lines.gloss_en: Then it's under warranty. We'll send a repair person.

lines.speaker: Juho
lines.gloss_en: On Thursday morning. Does that suit you?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.gloss_en: That's fine. Thanks for the help!
